title: Shared Test Vectors: Dual-impl congruence enforcement
description: Expand shared test/vectors/ coverage so spec compliance is enforced by vectors, not manual review. Every behavioral edge case gets a vector that both Python and Rust must pass. Goal: if impls diverge, CI catches it before humans do.
close_reason: All 10 sub-issues complete. Shared test vectors now cover all layers: Physical/Link, CCP, SCHC, IPv6, RPL/LOADng, OSCORE/Schnorr, CoAP, Gateway, Local Client, and Applications. Dual-impl congruence is enforced by vectors across Python and Rust.
